notes.title: 11/10/2016 Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

We pushed another patch live last night, here's the list!
-Fix for the 'after set phase hangup'
-Tournaments no longer expire after 24 hours (or ever)
-Tournament search is now 60 seconds instead of 30
-Fixed Draft Deck Bug
-Added visual progress bar for Draft Tournaments
-Tutorial Update - We Incorporated some of our player's feedback into the Tutorial

There were also some general stability updates, and the Tutorial Update will involve a tiny update to the Steam Client which should happen automatically. Notice that two of the list are suggestions from our community! That's no coincidence, we take our player feedback extremely seriously.

--Sean

notes.title: 11/7.2016 Update
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Saturday night we uploaded another patch. Since it was primarily a general stability patch, I didn't announce it until I was sure it worked. Two days of checking the server logs and playing later, things are looking super solid!

We've already got the next patch done, this one covering some minor bugs and other reported issues. That will probably go up tonight.

Since we're turning around these changes pretty regularly, this is a good time to report anything, or just give us some suggestions! To make sure Alteil is as good as it can be, we'll continue to listen to the community and impliment the great ideas of our players!

--Sean

notes.title: Steam Client Update - Curse of the Day 1 Patch!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26146107/f13abdd3ea31258de283555eefabe345460d11b5.jpg[/img]

Does it count as a day 1 patch if you haven't slept since launch? (Note -- if I'm still causing fixes 'day 1 patches' next week, notify a medical professional)

So after beating my head against a wall about what needed to be optimized, re-jiggered, ripped out or reworked, it turned out that it was just a good old fashioned teeny tiny bug (fixed by changing 5 characters, actually) that was red-lining some users CPU's. More importantly, it's gone now!  Two days of chatting with dozens of players revealed a pattern cued us in on checking the most unlikely and innocuous of places, leading to the fix. 

I want to Thank everyone I chatted with and everyone who reported problems, you guys are lifesavers!

--Sean

notes.title: 10/30/16 Stability Update
notes.content:
[img]http://news.apocoplay.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2016/01/buncle.jpg[/img]
Honored Iczers,Thank you so much for your reports these past 48 hours, they have been very helpful for us. We have managed to overcome a number of obstacles, but we are still working to improve. Tomorrow at 8AM (EST) we will be uploading a major stability patch that should significantly reduce (perhaps eliminate) most of the hang ups and freezes currently happening. We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. Please continue to communicate any difficulties you may be experiencing while playing Alteil: Horizons.We expect to be back up and running 30 minutes at approximately 8:30AM (EST)

See you in the arena,-Romdeau

notes.title: 10/28/16 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://news.apocoplay.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2016/01/dukes-guard.jpg[/img]

Honored Iczers and supporters,These past 24 hours have been a challenging learning experience for us. We have encountered a number of obstacles for players that we are doing our best to remove and correct.We have been reviewing all of the reports we have been receiving and combing for bugs. There is a critical underlying communication error that Logress (one of our programmers) is currently writing a fix for. Currently, we estimate a fix should be up and patched in by tonight.Thank you all for your reports and feedback. We will strive to do our best to create a smooth and seamless experience for players. There will be another update this upcoming Sunday and we will do our best to capture as many bugs as possible and fix them. With your reports, we can fix them faster and more thoroughly.
Thank you all for your continued support,

-Romdeau
